get_extension_value: get the current value of a protobuf message extension field using the extension handle as a key
set_extension_value: set a scalar extension field value on a protobuf message by assigning through the extension dict
check_extension_presence: check if a protobuf message extension field is populated using the in operator on the extension dict
find_extension_by_name: find a known extension field descriptor by its full name using _FindExtensionByName on the extension dict
find_extension_by_number: find a known extension field descriptor by its field number using _FindExtensionByNumber on the extension dict
